import html # Example template with placeholders for name, biography and status. PROFILE_FORMAT = """

{name}

{bio}

{status}
""" def render_user_profile(username: str, biography: str, status: str) -> str: """ Build a safe HTML snippet for displaying a user's profile. Parameters ---------- username : str The user-provided name. biography : str A potentially multi‑sentence bio written by the user. status : str The user's current short status message. Returns ------- str An HTML string with all user input properly escaped to prevent cross‑site scripting (XSS) or other injection attacks. Raises ------ TypeError If any argument is not a string. """ # Validate input types to avoid accidental injection via non‑string objects if not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in (username, biography, status)): raise TypeError("All arguments must be of type str") # Escape user input to neutralize special HTML characters safe_name = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(biography, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(status, quote=True) # Render the profile using the provided template return PROFILE_FORMAT.format(name=safe_name, bio=safe_bio, status=safe_status)
